messages.message: ### Step 2: Direct Translation Translate each source line into Hindi, guided by the Reference Translation and Step 1 analysis. Output: ONE Hindi line per source line (preserve line count and end punctuation). Rules: - Follow the meaning from Reference Translation. - For "so X that Y": keep resultative structure, do NOT convert to "because". - No internal punctuation; copy only end punctuation from source.
क्या तुम वही वर्जिल और वह स्रोत हो जो इतनी बड़ी वचन की धारा उत्पन्न करता है? मैंने उसे शर्मीले चेहरे के साथ उत्तर दिया।

### Step 3: Word Table & Coverage Check Build a word table from Step 2 translation, mapping each source word to its target equivalent. Output: ONE Markdown table (all lines combined). Columns: [Source Word] | [Contextual Definition] | [Target Word/Phrase] | [Back-Translation] | [Status: OK/MISSING/WRONG/GRAMMAR/UNNECESSARY] Mark GRAMMAR for agreement errors (gender, number, case) or other grammatical mistakes. Mark UNNECESSARY for elements present in source but not needed in target language (e.g., articles that target language omits naturally). After the table, list any MISSING, WRONG, GRAMMAR, or UNNECESSARY items.

**Word‑to‑Word Mapping Table**
| Source Word | Contextual Definition | Target Word / Phrase | Back‑Translation (EN) | Status | |-------------|-----------------------|----------------------|------------------------|--------| | **Or** | discourse marker “Now/then” | (omitted) | – | **UNNECESSARY** | | **se'** | copular “art” linking subject to predicate | **हो** | “are” | OK | | **tu** | 2nd‑person singular pronoun, addressee | **तुम** | “you” | OK | | **quel** | demonstrative “that” (modifying *Virgilio*) | **वही** | “that” | OK | | **Virgilio** | proper name, the poet Virgil | **वर्जिल** | “Virgil” | OK | | **e** | coordinating conjunction “and” | **और** | “and” | OK | | **quella** | demonstrative “that” (modifying *fonte*) | **वह** | “that” | OK | | **fonte** | metaphorical source of speech | **स्रोत** | “source/fount” | OK | | **che** | relative pronoun introducing clause | **जो** | “which/that” | OK | | **spandi** | verb “poureth forth, spreads” | **उत्पन्न करता** | “produces/creates” | OK | | **di** | preposition “of” (genitive) | **की** | “of” | OK | | **parlar** | noun “speech, words” | **वचन** | “speech” | OK | | **sì** | degree adverb “so” (intensifier) | **इतनी** | “so, such” | OK | | **largo** | adjective “large, big” | **बड़ी** | “large” | OK | | **fiume** | metaphorical “river/stream” of speech | **धारा** | “stream” | OK | | **rispuos'** | past verb “replied” (speech act) | **उत्तर दिया** | “gave an answer” | OK | | **io** | 1st‑person pronoun “I” (subject) | **मैंने** | “I (did)” | OK | | **lui** | 3rd‑person indirect object “to him” | **उसे** | “to him/it” | OK | | **con** | preposition “with” (instrument) | **के साथ** | “with” | OK | | **vergognosa** | adjective “bashful, embarrassed” | **शर्मीले** | “bashful” | OK | | **fronte** | noun “front, face” | **चेहरे** | “face” | OK |
---
### Items Requiring Attention - **UNNECESSARY:** *Or* – the discourse particle is not needed in Hindi; the interrogative particle **क्या** was introduced instead to form the question. - No other tokens are missing, wrong, or grammatically mismatched.

### Step 4: Correction & Final Output Fix any MISSING, WRONG, or GRAMMAR items from Step 3. Reorder within line if needed; do not add new content words. Verify that the output contains only Hindi script; no other language scripts should be mixed in. Output format (use nested bullet list, not table): - Line N: - Original: ... - Issue: ... (or "none") - Corrected: ... (or "no change") Output final Hindi text in ONE code block, line by line (no extra prose).

- **Line 79:** - Original: क्या तुम वही वर्जिल और वह स्रोत हो - Issue: none - Corrected: क्या तुम वही वर्जिल और वह स्रोत हो
- **Line 80:** - Original: जो इतनी बड़ी वचन की धारा उत्पन्न करता है? - Issue: none - Corrected: जो इतनी बड़ी वचन की धारा उत्पन्न करता है?
- **Line 81:** - Original: मैंने उसे शर्मीले चेहरे के साथ उत्तर दिया। - Issue: none - Corrected: मैंने उसे शर्मीले चेहरे के साथ उत्तर दिया।
